## Worst case found by search, and the error bounds used by the robust exact layer

Differential evolution maximising the max abs linear-minus-AC error over benign states, 1000 power flows per topology and quantity. delta = 1.25 x max(sample max, worst found); saved to `rules/model_error_bounds.json`. delta is an empirical bound, not a proof.
